test_gaussian_profile: test the formulas.gaussian_profile function generates a profile with correct shape and volume integral
test_exponential_profile: test the formulas.exponential_profile function generates a profile increasing toward decay_start
test_volume_integral_equals_total: test that volume_integration of gaussian_profile equals the specified total parameter
test_profile_peak_location: test that gaussian_profile peaks at the specified center and exponential_profile increases toward decay_start
test_profile_width_effects: test that narrower gaussian and exponential profiles produce steeper, more peaked results
